args.name: Cosy Coffee on a Rainy Windowsill — Vertical

style.prompt: A 6-second vertical 9:16 cosy illustrated animation. A warm ceramic coffee cup rests on a wooden windowsill beside a rain-streaked window. Delicate ribbons of steam gently curl upward continuously from the hot coffee. Raindrops slowly slide down the glass, with a softly blurred cool blue-grey rainy view outside. Warm amber indoor light, soft hand-painted textures, charming storybook illustration, muted comforting colours. Frame the cup in the lower-middle with ample space above for the curling steam. Locked-off steady camera, subtle calm natural motion, consistent cup shape and setting throughout, no cuts. No text, letters, logos, captions or watermarks. Silent, no sound or music.
